question: What is Ceeries?
answer: Ceeries is a Filipino lifestyle brand founded by Riona Karl Cee, created to offer stylish, practical, and affordable products especially for girls. Our collection includes bags, lip gloss, and scrunchies designed for everyday use.

question: What products does Ceeries offer?
answer: Ceeries offers a curated selection of bags, Hydra Slay Lip Oil, and scrunchies. Our products are designed to complement different styles, personalities, and everyday routines.

question: Who is Ceeries for?
answer: Ceeries is made especially for girls who want products that are stylish, practical, and affordable—whether you’re a student, young professional, or simply someone who loves adding little things to your everyday look.

question: Where is Ceeries based?
answer: Ceeries is a Filipino-owned brand serving customers in the Philippines.

question: How can I place an order?
answer: Browse the lip oils on the Ceeries website, select your preferred shade, and choose Inquire to contact us about your item. Each Hydra Slay Lip Oil is ₱199. Follow the ordering guidance provided when your inquiry is answered. This student-project preview saves inquiries locally.

question: Are Ceeries products affordable?
answer: Yes! Ceeries believes that looking and feeling good shouldn’t have to be expensive. We aim to offer products that balance style, quality, functionality, and affordability.

question: Are Ceeries products suitable for everyday use?
answer: Absolutely! Our products are thoughtfully selected with everyday routines in mind—from carrying your essentials to adding a little color and style to your look.

question: What shades are available for the Hydra Slay Lip Oil?
answer: Hydra Slay Lip Oil currently comes in seven shades: Gorg, Barbie, Diva, Hot, Queen, Icon, and Purr. Each shade has its own personality, so you can choose the one that fits your mood and style.

question: How do I choose the right lip oil shade?
answer: Choose based on the look you’re going for! Gorg is clear and natural, while Barbie gives a playful pink look. Diva is a bright orange, Hot is red, Queen is dark red, Icon is brown, and Purr is a soft nude.

question: How can I contact Ceeries?
answer: You can reach out to us through our official social media pages or the contact information provided on our website. Our team will be happy to assist you with your questions and concerns.

question: What makes Ceeries different?
answer: Ceeries goes beyond simply offering products. We want to be part of every girl’s everyday journey, self-expression, and new beginnings by creating a collection of pieces that are easy to enjoy, use, and make your own.

question: What does Ceeries stand for?
answer: Ceeries stands for confidence, individuality, and self-expression. We believe that even the little things we carry and use can reflect who we are.

question: Does Ceeries prioritize product quality?
answer: Yes. Reliable quality is part of our promise. We value the trust our customers place in us, which is why we strive to provide products that customers can confidently enjoy and use.
